method: 仅提取 ReFRAME 两个公开成员，核对 ZIP CRC32。以作者 inchikey_2d 的前14位与比赛训练全表的 inchikey14 对照。
sql: WITH ext AS (SELECT DISTINCT substr(inchikey_2d,1,14) AS key FROM read_parquet(?)), cmp AS (SELECT DISTINCT inchikey14 AS key FROM read_parquet('data/raw/train.parquet')) SELECT count(*) AS external_keys, count(cmp.key) AS seen_in_competition, count(*) FILTER(WHERE cmp.key IS NULL) AS outside_competition FROM ext LEFT JOIN cmp USING(key)
scope: 仅检查原始结构键是否出现。谱文件缺少逐谱 adduct、collision energy、采集标识；已见结构的独立采集/谱近重复待核查。

utrecht_secondary_screen.notes: 四个正质子条目均为酰基肉碱，第五个为双电荷 B12。Orbitrap NCE；仅核对作者结构清单，尚未按比赛身份及谱去重。
